fixes.en: A calmer interface: taglines, helper text and secondary labels are gone across the app.
fixes.zh: 界面更清爽：全应用移除了标语、辅助说明和次要标签。

fixes.en: Overleaf: documents created in the browser now sync as tracked suggestions when track changes is on.
fixes.zh: Overleaf：开启修订跟踪时，在浏览器中新建的文档现在会以修订建议的形式同步。

fixes.en: Pinned folders at the top of the file tree stay clean while you scroll fast.
fixes.zh: 快速滚动时，文件树顶部固定的文件夹保持整洁。
